Two rows are visible. In the longer lower passage the English instrumental preposition precedes the opening bracket. The following sentence continues visibly after the closing bracket.

samples.visualObservation: The conditional judgment is a short paragraph. The English has the bracketed verb before the directly rendered preposition and its object, and the entire passage fits near the top.
The account occupies one spread. The original place noun and the following one-word bracket are distinct in the source column. The longer script paragraph finishes above the outside folio.

bracketInkMethod: Each opening and closing mark was taken from the full 120 dpi Windows Qt page. Dark pixels inside its independently rasterized saved glyph outline were compared to the actual page pixels at the identical coordinates.
bracketContactSheetOrder: Each row shows an opening and closing mark from each column, cropped from the actual pages in reading order.
